problems.title: Severe Arsenic and Fluoride Contamination in Ground Well Drinking Water
problems.description: Handpumps and tube wells across Ward 6 and Ward 7 are pumping water with fluoride levels exceeding 3.8 mg/L. Multiple school children and elders are exhibiting dental and skeletal fluorosis symptoms.
problems.routing_rationale: Water & Sanitation keywords detected with 97% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Heavy Microbial & Coliform Contamination in Tap Pipeline Network
problems.description: Sewage drain breach directly adjacent to main municipal water distribution line in Ward 6. Water smells strongly of sulfur and contains fecal coliform, causing acute diarrhea outbreak.
problems.routing_rationale: Water & Sanitation keywords detected with 89% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Borewell Salinity and Iron Turbidity Damaging Filtration Systems
problems.description: Red sediment and extreme iron toxicity above safe drinking limits in community tanks across Ward 6 residential colonies.
problems.routing_rationale: Water & Sanitation keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Collapsed Concrete Culvert Causing Total Monsoon Inundation of Primary Health Center
problems.description: Heavy rains washed out the single bridge connecting 4 tribal hamlets to the Community Health Center (CHC). Ambulances cannot pass.
problems.routing_rationale: Roads & Infrastructure keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Persistent Stunting and Iron Deficiency Anemia in Anganwadi Centers
problems.description: Baseline clinical assessment revealed severe micronutrient deficiencies among children aged 1-5 years. Lack of affordable fortified indigenous nutritional supplements.
problems.routing_rationale: Healthcare & Nutrition keywords detected with 83% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Solar Microgrid Inverter Failure Plunging Primary Health Center into Darkness
problems.description: Vaccine cold storage refrigerators are failing repeatedly due to unstable off-grid power supply. Needs intelligent low-cost hybrid power backup.
problems.routing_rationale: Clean Energy keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Lack of Cold Chain Storage for Perishable Litchi and Guava Produce
problems.description: Smallholder farmers are losing over 45% of their seasonal harvest within 48 hours of picking due to zero evaporative cooling or decentralized cold storage facilities.
problems.routing_rationale: Agriculture & Irrigation keywords detected with 83% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Hazardous Unsegregated Biomedical Waste Dumped Near River Subarnarekha
problems.description: Untreated clinic and hospital syringes, plastic drip bags, and medical refuse accumulating on riverbanks, causing leachate leakage into downstream farm irrigation.
problems.routing_rationale: Waste & Environment keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Digital Divide: Rural Secondary School Lacks Affordable Offline Interactive Science Kits
problems.description: Over 350 high school students have no science laboratory equipment or digital tools to study Physics, Chemistry, and Math experiments.
problems.routing_rationale: Education & Skill Development keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Ranchi.

problems.title: Pest Infestation of Fall Armyworm Ravaging Maize Fields in Palamu
problems.description: Over 600 acres of small-scale corn crops devastated by invasive caterpillars within two weeks. Farmers lack biological pest management methods.
problems.routing_rationale: Agriculture & Irrigation keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Palamu.

problems.title: Severe Groundwater Depletion and Saline Water Encroachment in Marathwada
problems.description: Borewells running dry at 800 feet depth. Farming community desperately requires low-cost check dam models and continuous IoT soil moisture telemetry.
problems.routing_rationale: Agriculture & Irrigation keywords detected with 83% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Aurangabad.

problems.title: Textile Dyeing Effluent Discharged into Noyyal River Basin
problems.description: Untreated chemical azo dyes and high TDS discharge into surface water channels, poisoning ground water in agricultural fields across 8 villages.
problems.routing_rationale: Waste & Environment keywords detected with 83% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Tiruppur.

problems.title: High Maternal Mortality Linked to Delayed Blood Transfusions in Remote Tribal Belts
problems.description: No drone logistics or active refrigerated transit for life-saving O-negative blood units between District Hospital and Primary Health Centers.
problems.routing_rationale: Healthcare & Nutrition keywords detected with 83% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Gadchiroli.

problems.title: Frequent Landslides Severing Rural Hill Transport Corridor on NH-108
problems.description: Unstable shale slopes collapse during every pre-monsoon shower, trapping milk vans and school buses. Slope stabilization bio-engineering urgently needed.
problems.routing_rationale: Disaster & Safety keywords detected with 86% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Uttarkashi.

problems.title: Extreme Rice Crop Stubble Burning Generating Severe Smog in Western UP
problems.description: Over 12,000 hectares of paddy fields set on fire due to lack of accessible mechanical in-situ mulching or microbial decomposers.
problems.routing_rationale: Waste & Environment keywords detected with 81% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Meerut.

problems.title: Heavy Metal Lead Poisoning in Children Near Informal Battery Recycling Units
problems.description: Informal open-air smelting of lead-acid vehicle batteries in urban slums resulting in dangerously elevated blood lead levels in toddlers.
problems.routing_rationale: Healthcare & Nutrition keywords detected with 83% confidence; high civic vulnerability in Patna.

adoptions.proposal_title: Nanofiltration & Graphene-Adsorbent Point-of-Use Community Fluoride Removal Unit
adoptions.proposal_text: Deployment of low-cost activated alumina and modified biochar filtration columns capable of treating 2000L/day with continuous fluoride sensor telemetry.

adoptions.proposal_title: Rapid Ultraviolet & Electrolytic Chlorine Dosing In-Line Disinfection System
adoptions.proposal_text: Solar-powered compact disinfection manifold fitted onto the municipal pipeline intake with IoT water purity probes.

adoptions.proposal_title: Indigenous Millets & Moringa-Enriched Therapeutic Food Paste for Anganwadis
adoptions.proposal_text: Standardized decentralized manufacturing of high-protein, micronutrient-dense ready-to-use therapeutic food formulated from local Jharkhand farm crops.

industry_supports.notes: Sanctioned under Eastern India Clean Drinking Water CSR Grant 2026.
Supply chain distribution partnership with 40 Anganwadis.

mou_agreements.template_title: Collaborative Civic Innovation & IP Co-Ownership Agreement (SIH-Standard)
mou_agreements.terms_summary: Joint patent rights on municipal water filter technology. University retains academic publishing rights. Tata Trusts deploys across 50 eastern Indian villages royalty-free. Citizen public good usage guaranteed.
